en: Farm work?
That sounds interesting.
May I come and watch?
Watch all you like, but
don't get in the way.
Ah,
note: Shared by Katusa (msg 58469, alone) and Wendy ('Ah, ' + name + '.'); trailing space needed for Wendy

en: Another fine day today.
Want to help me out again?
I'm just on my way home.
Hey, good evening.
It'll be dark soon. You'd best get home, too.
Come by my place sometime.
My wife'll give you a meal.
I'm telling you, don't come around so much.
If you want to talk, I'll hear you out later,
Quit hanging around here and go home.
Glad you came. Sit down and eat.
Yes, it's fascinating.
Is that so? Then it can't be helped.
I'm interested in both.
Both...?
I don't mind you watching from there.
note: Self-contained so it works with #1267 whatever follows

en: Is farm work really that unusual to you?
Well, it's harvest time right now,
note: Ends with a comma; #1271 (slice 015) must read as a continuation, e.g. 'but the rest of the year the work is plainer.'

en: We grow wheat and such around here, but
this year is no good.
Take a look around that tower. The land is ruined,
and not a single weed grows.
On top of that, even the wheat over here is weak this year.
It's a real worry.
What? I'm to do the harvesting?
Yeah. It might come in handy someday.
Besides, most of it's already done.
Here, let me show you the knack...
Truth is, I'd like to plow the land by that tower, too.
But somehow it feels hard to go near.
Somehow, that place feels forsaken by God.
It's just a feeling I get.
No field survives once God forsakes it.
So I'm leaving it alone.
Y-you're
Helping with the farm work was fun.
In return, so to speak,
I'm terribly sorry, but...
Please help me out, too.
note: No used_in; spoken by [PLAYER] right after #1324 (blood-taking scene); not referenced by any message

en: S-stop it
note: No used_in; Katusa, probably followed by shared '...' like #1327

en: Nngaaah
Please don't resist so much.
It's for the village's sake, too.
I'm sure it will be over soon.
, my master
note: Servant (Lehn) addressing the player: name + ', my master' + '...'

en: Your orders
I would do anything for you.
Welcome. Are you a traveler?
No, I have a place to live.
Oh. I see.
This is an inn.
I've no use for people who aren't staying.
You can go now.
If you're staying, come when we're open.
If you're not, don't come.
Come when the inn is open.
I can't have people showing up at my house.
So you really did come.
Want some of my stew?
I'll give you a bargain price.
Well, eating now and then wouldn't be bad.
Really?
Still, a good payer is always welcome.
note: Shortened to fit 3 lines in msgs 62236 and 62660

en: Now, come over here and wait, please.
Come again any time.
Oh, I see.
I've no use for people who don't stay.
I told you, this is an inn.
I've no use for the likes of you.
I'm the owner, Lehn.
What's your name?
So, you want to stay here?
Then I'll let you stay.
